title: PDP Niger State Governorship Camp Backs Tinubu's 2027 Re-Election Bid
detail: The PDP governorship camp in Niger State has publicly aligned with President Bola Tinubu's 2027 re-election bid, signalling a notable cross-party political realignment ahead of the general election. The move underscores growing defections and coalition-building around the APC incumbent as the campaign season approaches.

media.caption: PDP Niger State camp backs Tinubu 2027 re-election
